conditions.title: Terms for host organisations
conditions.costDesc: The thesis is part of the degree. A travel and meal allowance is possible at the company's discretion.

section1.title: 1. Live Market Scanner & Volume Filter
section1.p1: I built this scanner to watch over 200 crypto pairs on Binance at once. Instead of showing noisy coins, it filters for pairs with at least $10M in daily volume and highlights the top movers.
section1.p2: The scanner ranks coins by volatility and selects the top 5 momentum gainers to spot active trends immediately.

section2.title: 2. Paper Trading Simulator & Risk Calculator
section2.p1: To test trading ideas without risking real money, I built a virtual trading engine that adapts to whether the market is trending or flat.
section2.p2: It uses the Kelly Criterion formula to automatically size positions so a single trade never risks more than 2% of the portfolio.

section3.title: 3. Trading212 API Integration & Hybrid Telemetry
section3.p1: The platform's visualization layer employs a hybrid architecture designed to deliver real-time telemetry feedback alongside high-density multi-timeframe financial charts. Deep candlestick inspection is handled by embedding hardware-accelerated TradingView charts with custom toolbar and styling overrides, providing institutional indicators and interactive drawing tools.
section3.p2: For portfolio telemetry and equity performance, the frontend utilizes Recharts to render virtual balance history, equity curves, and asset allocation distributions without DOM frame stutter. Modular API adapters interface with Trading 212 API telemetry endpoints and Binance WebSocket streaming connections, ensuring price ticks and simulated fill events update reactively without memory leakage.

section4.title: 3. AI Market News Summary
section4.p1: Instead of reading dozens of articles every morning, I connected the Groq LLaMA 3.3 model to read the latest financial headlines and market data.
section4.p2: It scores the overall market mood from -1.0 (bearish) to +1.0 (bullish) and writes a short daily summary.
